Sakura Laurel was defeated in the Satsuki 
Sho. The barrier of the Classic triple 
crown route was high. The crowd was 
thoroughly electrified by the high-level 
battle.

Among them, Narita Brian's running drew 
the most attention. Sakura Laurel watched 
that extraordinary, razor-sharp stride— 
something she herself did not possess—

—Her desire to surpass that ultimate 
running style and win is boiling fiercely 
within her. She wants to fight in the 
Japanese Derby.

A race to decide the pinnacle of their 
generation. Sakura Laurel's heart became 
entirely captivated by the Nippon Derby, a 
once-in-a-lifetime race.
